nodes.label: Large graph.json diffs in pull requests are expected
nodes.norm_label: large graph.json diffs in pull requests are expected
nodes.rationale: A committed graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, so its large diff is not churn to flag.

nodes.label: Run graphify query before raw search
nodes.norm_label: run graphify query before raw search
nodes.rationale: Scoped query, path and explain output is usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: Run graphify update after code changes
nodes.norm_label: run graphify update after code changes
nodes.rationale: Keeps the graph current; AST-only rebuild with no API cost.

nodes.label: Type-aware ESLint rules
nodes.rationale: Recommended when developing a production application.

nodes.label: React Compiler (not enabled)
nodes.rationale: Left disabled in the template because of its impact on dev and build performance.

nodes.label: Allow all crawlers
nodes.rationale: Every user agent is allowed to crawl every path.

nodes.label: Embedding does not change document license
nodes.norm_label: embedding does not change document license
nodes.rationale: Embedding an OFL font in a document does not change the license of that document.

nodes.label: Reserved Font Name Alpha Lyrae
nodes.rationale: Modified versions cannot use the reserved name, so a derivative needs its own font name.

nodes.label: @font-face web use is distribution
nodes.rationale: Serving the font through @font-face is explicitly allowed as distribution rather than embedding.

nodes.label: WOFF conversion rule
nodes.rationale: WOFF conversion is not a modification only if font data and metadata are unchanged apart from compression.

nodes.label: ETAO glyph ordering
nodes.rationale: Letters and OpenType classes are ordered by English letter frequency rather than alphabetically.

nodes.label: Fourth-glyph substitution rule
nodes.rationale: Under CALT every fourth glyph, including spaces and punctuation, switches to the SS01 set.

nodes.label: Repeat-within-five-letters rule
nodes.rationale: An SS01 letter repeated within the following five letters switches to SS02.
